get.description: Server-filtered history ordered by stored run startedAt descending, then run ID descending. Filters are combined with AND and bound to the cursor; changing any filter requires a fresh first page. Guest, node and target IDs refer to the persisted request, not current guest placement. Names and VMID come from retained inventory, including archived objects. startedAt marks the beginning of a run attempt, not confirmation of a Proxmox task. Pending requests without a run are absent.

parameters.name: nodeId
parameters.description: Node recorded in the request, independent of current placement.

parameters.name: targetId
parameters.description: Backup target recorded in the request, including disabled targets.

parameters.name: vmid
parameters.description: Exact VMID, across clusters. Combine with guestId or nodeId to disambiguate. Canonical positive decimal query value without leading zeros.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Literal guest-name substring, case-insensitive under the database Unicode collation. SQL wildcard characters are literal. Nonblank, at most 190 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters.

parameters.name: startedFrom
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on stored run start time. UTC with Z and optional 1-6 fractional seconds; years 1000-9999. Invalid calendar values are rejected.

parameters.name: startedBefore
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on stored run start time; must be greater than startedFrom when both are supplied. UTC with Z and optional 1-6 fractional seconds; years 1000-9999. Invalid calendar values are rejected.

MaintenanceUnavailable.description: Persistent deployment maintenance temporarily blocks application requests; retry after the Retry-After interval.

AuthenticationRequired.description: A valid local web session is required.

InvalidQuery.description: Unknown, malformed, incompatible, or out-of-bounds query.

ReadModelUnavailable.description: The read-only projection is temporarily unavailable without exposing database or runtime details.

CommandApplied.description: The command was applied or replayed idempotently.

InvalidCommand.description: The command envelope or closed payload is invalid.

CommandConflict.description: The expected revision or idempotency payload conflicts.

CommandBlocked.description: Activation is blocked by configuration or fresh evidence.

CommandUnavailable.description: The configuration command store is temporarily unavailable.

OnboardingApplied.description: The fully verified onboarding mutation was applied or replayed idempotently.

OnboardingRejected.description: TLS, product, role, permission, or propagation evidence failed closed.

OnboardingUnavailable.description: The read-only onboarding verification or atomic local persistence is temporarily unavailable.

SecurityCommandBlocked.description: The last-admin, self-lockout, or user-state invariant blocked the command.

SecurityCommandUnavailable.description: The security administration store is temporarily unavailable.

host.description: DNS host name or IPv4/IPv6 literal only; URL schemes, paths, and embedded ports are forbidden.

oneOf.description: One or more valid PEM-encoded X.509 CA certificates.

failureNotificationRecipients.description: Drafts may be saved without recipients, but at least one recipient is required before a policy can be enabled or execute a backup.
